limitations: Machine-extracted L1 cases are not human-verified; L2 requires REVIEWED_L2_CASE_IDS.
related_provision_ids contain only Civil Code articles 1-1260. Judicial interpretations and other statutes remain unresolved raw citations and are not rewritten as civil-code IDs.
Only cases whose pleadings clearly seek service-contract termination and unperformed-fee refund enter the deep comparison set. Property-damage claims are excluded from that template.
CourtFinding records are taken from 法院经审理查明/法院认定, never from 诉称 or 辩称.
Condition mapping is conservative machine heuristics and always sets human_verified=false.
